## Validation

- [ ] `cargo fmt --all -- --check`
- [ ] `cargo clippy --workspace --all-targets -- -D warnings`
- [ ] `cargo test --workspace`
- [ ] `pnpm --dir apps/desktop build`
- [ ] English and Japanese UI strings were updated together, if applicable
- [ ] No confidential files, paths, credentials, or user data are included
